    DESIGN ASSETS — the complete, self-contained source of the AI Done Right design system¶

    This file needs no other files. It contains the ACTUAL source of the shared design kit (tokens, component styles, layout styles, the React components, the portfolio config) plus one COMPLETE worked app (Teleon), verbatim. Read DESIGN-BIBLE.md for the guide and rules; this file is the code those rules describe. Pair it with DESIGN-BIBLE.md + INTEGRATION-BIBLE.md and you have the whole system, nothing external required.

    The system in one paragraph: every surface is a React 18 app (rendered in-browser via Babel-standalone, no build step) that imports ONE shared kit: oh-tokens.css (the design tokens) + oh-components.css + oh-site.css (the styles) + oh-site.jsx (the components: OhTopBar, OhHero, OhSection, OhFeatures, OhBand, OhFooter, OhAppShell, plus the useHashRoute/navigate hooks) + products.js (the portfolio config and per-brand accents). All 5 surfaces share this kit and differ ONLY by their accent and their copy. Light theme, Inter UI font, ui-monospace for code/labels. Copy rules: no placeholders ("OpenHubForAI" not "Open*Hubs"), no em or en dashes, no strategy leakage, real sales/marketing copy.

    1. Design tokens — palette, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, the 5 accents¶

    /* ============================================================
   OpenHubForAI — design tokens
   One component layer (oh-components.css) consumes these vars.
   Six scopes: {dir-a | dir-b | dir-d} × {theme-light | theme-dark}.
   Primitive-legend hues stay close to the shipped identity; only the
   ACCENT and the Action-primitive coupling differ per direction.
   ============================================================ */

.oh {
  /* radius + motion are largely shared; directions retune below */
  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r-md: 9px;
  --r-lg: 12px;
  --r-pill: 999px;
  --r-node: 10px;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);

  --font-sans: "Inter", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace;
  --font-display: var(--font-sans);

  /* primitive-legend defaults (dark-surface palette / shipped) */
  --p-input: #8b949e;
  --p-knowledge: #3fb950;
  --p-conditional: #d29922;
  --p-action: #fb7714;
  --p-loop: #a371f7;
  --p-stop: #f85149;
  --p-output: #58a6ff;
  --operator: #e3b341;

  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--fg);
  background: var(--bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

/* light-surface primitive palette (darkened for AA on white/paper) */
.oh.theme-light {
  --p-input: #5b6470;
  --p-knowledge: #1a7f37;
  --p-conditional: #9a6700;
  --p-action: #c2410c;
  --p-loop: #6e40c9;
  --p-stop: #cf222e;
  --p-output: #0969da;
  --operator: #8a6d1f;
}

/* ===========================================================
   DIRECTION A — Warm Editorial "Paper"
   Newsreader serif display · Inter UI · clay accent == Action
   =========================================================== */
.oh.dir-a { --font-display: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; }

.oh.dir-a.theme-light {
  --bg: #faf7f0;
  --bg-subtle: #f3eee2;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --panel-2: #fbf8f1;
  --line: #e7e0d2;
  --line-strong: #d6cdb9;
  --fg: #1c1b19;
  --fg-muted: #6b675e;
  --fg-faint: #868074;

  --accent: #b8501f;            /* refined clay — evolves the orange */
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --accent-weak: #fbeee4;
  --success: #1a7f37;
  --warning: #9a6700;
  --danger: #c0392b;
  --info: #1f6fb2;
  --verified: #0e7c86;          /* teal — the moat color */

  --p-action: #b8501f;          /* A couples accent <-> Action */
  --e1: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,40,20,.05);
  --e2: 0 10px 30px rgba(60,40,20,.10);
}

.oh.dir-a.theme-dark {
  --bg: #1b1a17;
  --bg-subtle: #131210;
  --panel: #242220;
  --panel-2: #1f1d1a;
  --line: #353230;
  --line-strong: #4a4641;
  --fg: #f1ece2;
  --fg-muted: #a59d8f;
  --fg-faint: #797266;

  --accent: #d8743a;
  --accent-ink: #1b1206;
  --accent-weak: #2e2114;
  --success: #4cc35f;
  --warning: #e0a93a;
  --danger: #f06258;
  --info: #6fb0e8;
  --verified: #39c5cf;

  --p-action: #d8743a;
  --e1: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  --e2: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}

   Polished, governed, procurement-ready. Light primary.
   =========================================================== */
.oh.dir-h { --font-display: "IBM Plex Sans", "Inter", sans-serif; }

.oh.dir-h.theme-light {
  --bg: #fcfdfe;
  --bg-subtle: #f3f6fa;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --panel-2: #f6f9fc;
  --line: #e4e9f0;
  --line-strong: #cbd5e2;
  --fg: #15233b;
  --fg-muted: #5c6b82;
  --fg-faint: #79869a;

  --accent: #1f5fbf;            /* corporate blue */
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --accent-weak: #e8f0fc;
  --success: #1a7f37;
  --warning: #9a6700;
  --danger: #cf222e;
  --info: #1f5fbf;
  --verified: #0e7c86;
  --e1: 0 1px 2px rgba(21,35,59,.06);
  --e2: 0 12px 32px rgba(21,35,59,.12);
}

.oh.dir-h.theme-dark {
  --bg: #0c1320;
  --bg-subtle: #070c16;
  --panel: #131d30;
  --panel-2: #0f1827;
  --line: #233248;
  --line-strong: #364866;
  --fg: #e6edf6;
  --fg-muted: #8c9cb4;
  --fg-faint: #5e6f89;

  --accent: #4d8de6;
  --accent-ink: #040a14;
  --accent-weak: #0f2138;
  --success: #4cc35f;
  --warning: #e0a93a;
  --danger: #f06258;
  --info: #6fb0e8;
  --verified: #39c5cf;

  --p-action: #fb7714;
  --p-knowledge: #3fb950;
  --p-output: #58a6ff;
  --e1: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  --e2: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}

/* ===========================================================
   DIRECTION S — ★ Harness House Style  (the synthesis)
   Grafts: A's editorial warmth · B's restraint · D's verified-teal
   Space Grotesk display · Inter UI · JetBrains Mono · ember accent
   (couples to Action for brand continuity). Built to score 5/5.
   =========================================================== */
.oh.dir-s { --font-display: "Hanken Grotesk", "Inter", sans-serif; }

.oh.dir-s.theme-light {
  --bg: #fafaf8;
  --bg-subtle: #f1f0ec;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --panel-2: #f8f7f3;
  --line: #e7e5dd;
  --line-strong: #d5d2c7;
  --fg: #161513;
  --fg-muted: #66635b;
  --fg-faint: #868277;

  --accent: #d6553a;            /* refined ember — evolves the brand orange */
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --accent-weak: #fbede7;
  --success: #1a7f37;
  --warning: #9a6700;
  --danger: #c0392b;
  --info: #1f6fb2;
  --verified: #0e7c86;

  --p-action: #c2410c;
  --e1: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,30,20,.05);
  --e2: 0 12px 34px rgba(40,30,20,.11);
}

.oh.dir-s.theme-dark {
  --bg: #121110;
  --bg-subtle: #0c0b0a;
  --panel: #1b1a18;
  --panel-2: #161513;
  --line: #2a2825;
  --line-strong: #3d3a35;
  --fg: #f2efe9;
  --fg-muted: #a39e94;
  --fg-faint: #726d64;

  --accent: #e2603a;
  --accent-ink: #160a05;
  --accent-weak: #2c1b12;
  --success: #4cc35f;
  --warning: #e0a93a;
  --danger: #f06258;
  --info: #6fb0e8;
  --verified: #2dd4bf;

  --p-action: #e2603a;
  --p-knowledge: #3fb950;
  --p-output: #58a6ff;
  --e1: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  --e2: 0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}


/* Global font floor — nothing falls back to the UA serif (private-preview banner etc.). */
html, body { font-family: var(--font-sans, "Inter", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); }

    2. Component styles — buttons, cards, inputs, badges, the atoms¶

    /* ============================================================
   OpenHubForAI — component layer
   Every atom designed once; all values come from oh-tokens.css.
   Artifact roots are sized to the artboard via inline width/height
   from app.jsx; these styles fill that frame.
   ============================================================ */

.oh { box-sizing: border-box; }
.oh *, .oh *::before, .oh *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.oh .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; }

/* ---- accessibility foundation: visible focus, never color-alone, motion ---- */
.oh :focus-visible,
.oh-sw button:focus-visible,
.oh-sw-opt:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px;
}
.oh button, .oh a, .oh [role="button"], .oh-chip, .oh-legend-chip { cursor: pointer; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .oh *, .oh-sw *, .oh-sw-trigger .cv { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; }
}
.oh .eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-muted);
}

/* ---- buttons ---- */
.oh-btn {
  font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650;
  border-radius: var(--r-md); border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: all .12s var(--ease);
}
.oh-btn--primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.oh-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--line); }
.oh-btn--sm { padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 13px; }

/* ---- card primitive: ONE canonical surface for every card & panel ----
   Use `.oh-card` for the surface; add `--pad` for default padding and
   `--interactive` for the hover-lift affordance on clickable cards.
   Per-site card classes (.ce-card, .cie-* cards) compose these tokens. */
/* `.pt-panel` (OpenHubForAI) is a compatibility alias of the canonical surface. */
.oh-card,
.pt-panel {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
}
.oh-card--pad,
.pt-panel { padding: var(--pad-card); }
.oh-card--interactive { transition: border-color .14s var(--ease), transform .14s var(--ease), box-shadow .14s var(--ease); }
.oh-card--interactive:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, var(--line));
  transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--e2);
}

/* ---- canonical scale: ONE type/space/chrome scale shared by every site ----
   Sites differ ONLY by accent color (token scope). Padding, font sizes, chrome
   dimensions and the display face are identical everywhere. */
.oh {
  --fs-eyebrow: 11px;   --ls-eyebrow: .14em;
  --fs-h1: clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 52px);
  --fs-h2: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 34px);
  --fs-h3: 19px;
  --fs-page-title: 30px;
  --fs-lead: 18px;      --lh-lead: 1.58;
  --fs-body: 15px;      --lh-body: 1.6;
  --fs-small: 13px;
  --pad-card: 22px;
  --pad-panel: 28px;
  --h-topbar: 64px;
  --maxw-site: 1120px;
  /* ---- canonical body-layout scaffolds (shared by every site) ---- */
  --w-sidebar: 240px;
  --maxw-page: 1120px;
  --maxw-page-wide: 1340px;
  --gap-split: 18px;
}
/* shared body-layout primitives — same scaffolds across products (color aside) */
.oh-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--w-sidebar) 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }
.oh-page { max-width: var(--maxw-page); margin: 0 auto; padding: 34px 36px 64px; }
.oh-page--wide { max-width: var(--maxw-page-wide); }
.oh-split { display: grid; gap: var(--gap-split); align-items: start; }
.oh-split--rail { grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr; }   /* T-view: rail + canvas */
.oh-split--even { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
@media (max-width: 1000px) { .oh-split, .oh-split--rail, .oh-split--even { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* ---- canonical form / component primitives (one definition for the whole family) ----
   Per-site twins (.ce-*, .pt-*) should migrate onto these so they can never drift. */
.oh-pagehead { margin-bottom: 22px; }
.oh-pagehead h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-page-title); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); margin: 8px 0 0; }
.oh-pagehead .sub { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 10px; max-width: 64ch; }

.oh-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 22px; }
.oh-tab { padding: 10px 16px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px;
          font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.oh-tab:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.oh-tab.on { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

.oh-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-pill); }
.oh-seg button { padding: 6px 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: transparent; font-family: inherit;
                 font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.oh-seg button.on { background: var(--panel); color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--e1); }

.oh-switch { width: 40px; height: 23px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: var(--line-strong); position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; padding: 0; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.oh-switch i { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: transform .15s; }
.oh-switch.on { background: var(--accent); }
.oh-switch.on i { transform: translateX(17px); }

.oh-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.oh-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase;
               color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 0 12px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.oh-table td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--fg); vertical-align: middle; }
.oh-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

.oh-setrow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.oh-setrow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.oh-setrow .info .t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-setrow .info .d { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 3px; line-height: 1.45; }

.oh-meter { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-subtle); overflow: hidden; }
.oh-meter > i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); transition: width .5s var(--ease); }

.oh-code { background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); font-family: var(--font-mono);
           font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--fg); padding: 18px 20px; overflow-x: auto; }

.oh-banner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
             border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent-weak);
             font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--fg); }

.oh-stat { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); padding: 16px 18px; }
.oh-stat .v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-stat .k { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 3px; }
/* shared label + heading primitives */
.oh-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-eyebrow); font-weight: 700;
              letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.oh-section-label { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
                    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.oh-section-label::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
.oh-h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h1); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
.oh-h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h2); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.025em; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
.oh-lead { font-size: var(--fs-lead); line-height: var(--lh-lead); color: var(--fg-muted); }

/* ---- shared interactive + account-layer primitives ----
   Tabs, tables, segmented control, form fields, switch and the settings/billing/
   usage "setrow". Defined ONCE here; every product (Baltor/OpenHubForAI/CIE) uses these
   classes directly so account, billing and usage layouts are identical house-wide. */
.oh-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 22px; }
.oh-tab { padding: 10px 16px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px;
          font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.oh-tab:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.oh-tab.on { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

.oh-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.oh-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase;
               color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 0 12px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.oh-table td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--fg); vertical-align: middle; }
.oh-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

.oh-segment { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-pill); }
.oh-segment button { padding: 6px 13px; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: transparent; font-family: inherit;
                     font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.oh-segment button.on { background: var(--panel); color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--e1); }

.oh-field { display: block; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.oh-field > span { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-bottom: 7px; }
.oh-field input, .oh-field textarea, .oh-field select { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px;
              color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 11px 13px; }
.oh-field input:focus, .oh-field textarea:focus, .oh-field select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); }
.oh-input { font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
            border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 8px 11px; min-width: 240px; }
.oh-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); }
/* keyboard users still get a visible ring on inputs (mouse focus keeps the clean border) */
.oh-input:focus-visible, .oh-field input:focus-visible, .oh-field textarea:focus-visible, .oh-field select:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

.oh-setrow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.oh-setrow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.oh-setrow .info { min-width: 0; }
.oh-setrow .info .t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-setrow .info .d { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 3px; line-height: 1.45; }
.oh-setrow .ctrl { flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* ============================================================
   MARKETING SHELL + HERO ENTRY BOX  (artifact ①)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-mkt { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
          background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.oh-topbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px;
  padding: 0 36px; height: 60px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg);
}
.oh-wordmark {
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px;
  letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--fg); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
}
.oh-mark {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.oh-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; margin-left: 8px; }
.oh-nav a { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; }
.oh-nav a:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.oh-topbar-spacer { flex: 1; }

.oh-hero {
  flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; padding: 0 40px 64px; text-align: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, var(--bg-subtle) 0%, transparent 55%);
}
.oh-hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 50px;
  line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.022em; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 14px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.oh-hero-sub {
  font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg-muted);
  max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto 34px; text-wrap: balance;
}
.oh-entrybox {
  width: 100%; max-width: 660px; background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--e2); padding: 18px 18px 14px; text-align: left;
  transition: border-color .15s var(--ease), box-shadow .15s var(--ease);
}
.oh-entrybox:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); }
.oh-entry-text {
  font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--fg-faint); min-height: 58px;
}
.oh-entry-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 12px; }
.oh-entry-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.oh-constraint-add {
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 5px 11px; cursor: pointer;
}
.oh-kbd {
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 6px; background: var(--bg-subtle);
}
.oh-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; justify-content: center;
            max-width: 620px; margin: 22px auto 0; }
.oh-chip {
  font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  padding: 7px 14px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  transition: border-color .12s, color .12s;
}
.oh-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.oh-chip .tri { color: var(--accent); }
.oh-quietlinks { margin-top: 30px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
                 font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-quietlinks a { color: var(--fg-muted); text-decoration: none; }
.oh-quietlinks a:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.oh-quietlinks .dot { opacity: .5; }
.oh-howstrip {
  flex: 0 0 auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-subtle);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0;
  padding: 16px 40px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted);
}
.oh-howstrip .step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 18px; }
.oh-howstrip .step b { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-howstrip .arr { color: var(--fg-faint); }

/* ============================================================
   BUILDER RESULTS — three costed options  (artifact ②)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-app { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden;
          display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.oh-appbar {
  height: 52px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px;
  padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel);
}
.oh-cmdk {
  flex: 1; max-width: 360px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--bg-subtle); display: flex;
  align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-faint);
}
.oh-cmdk .oh-kbd { margin-left: auto; }
.oh-results-head { padding: 26px 32px 6px; }
.oh-results-head h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;
                      letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-results-head .task { font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.oh-results-head .task .mono { color: var(--fg); }
.oh-results-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; padding: 18px 32px 28px; }
.oh-result {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 13px; position: relative;
}
.oh-result--rec { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.oh-result-tierrow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.oh-tier { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
           color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-tier--rec { color: var(--accent); }
.oh-rec-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase;
                color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); }
.oh-result .count { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-result-lift { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.oh-result-lift .big { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--success);
                       line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.oh-result-lift .sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-result-src { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); line-height: 1.4; }
.oh-result-src b { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-result-cost { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
                  padding-top: 9px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oh-result-cost .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-result-cost .freeze { color: var(--verified); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-minidag {
  background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 16px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; min-height: 92px;
}
.oh-mininode {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 7px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  font-size: 13px; color: #fff; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.oh-mininode.is-op { border-radius: 50%; background: transparent !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--operator); color: var(--operator); width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.oh-miniedge { width: 12px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--line-strong); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.oh-result-stats { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; }
.oh-statline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; }
.oh-statline .lbl { color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-statline .val { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; }

/* ============================================================
   BADGES & CHIPS  (the trust/meaning layer)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--fg-muted); white-space: nowrap;
}
.oh-badge .gl { font-size: 12px; }
.oh-badge.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11.5px; }
.oh-badge--lift { color: var(--success); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 35%, transparent);
                  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 9%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-badge--verified { color: var(--verified); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--verified) 38%, transparent);
                      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--verified) 10%, transparent); }
.oh-badge--warn { color: var(--warning); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 38%, transparent);
                  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 10%, transparent); }
.oh-badge--danger { color: var(--danger); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 38%, transparent);
                    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent); }
.oh-badge--muted { color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oh-badge--stable { color: var(--fg-muted); }
.oh-execdot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-block; }

/* ============================================================
   COMPONENT CARD + BADGE SYSTEM  (artifact ③)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-card-stage { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden;
                 padding: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
.oh-card-stage .stage-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; }
.oh-card-stage .stage-head h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700;
                                 margin: 0; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-card-stage .stage-head span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); }

.oh-comp-card {
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--e1); padding: 16px 17px; width: 360px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--p-action);
  transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s, transform .12s;
}
.oh-comp-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--e2); }
.oh-cc-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.oh-cc-prim { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
              letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--p-action); }
.oh-cc-prim .sub { color: var(--fg-muted); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-cc-top .spacer { flex: 1; }
.oh-cc-kebab { color: var(--fg-faint); cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }
.oh-cc-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em;
              color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 3px; }
.oh-cc-id { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint);
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
.oh-cc-id .copy { opacity: .6; }
.oh-cc-desc { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 13px;
              display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
.oh-cc-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 0 -17px 12px; }
.oh-cc-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; }

/* badge-system legend grid */
.oh-badgesys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px 28px; }
.oh-badgesys .grp { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.oh-badgesys .grp .gh { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
                        color: var(--fg-faint); }
.oh-badgesys .grp .row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

/* ============================================================
   DAG CANVAS + LEGEND + NODES + OPERATOR  (artifact ④)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-canvas-stage { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden;
                   display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.oh-legend-bar {
  flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel);
}
.oh-legend-bar .lt { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
                     color: var(--fg-faint); margin-right: 4px; }
.oh-legend-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  padding: 4px 10px 4px 6px; cursor: help; background: var(--panel-2);
}
.oh-legend-chip .sw { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 4px; display: grid; place-items: center;
                      font-size: 9px; color: #fff; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.oh-legend-chip.is-op .sw { border-radius: 50%; background: transparent !important;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--operator); color: var(--operator); }

/* ---- FLOW canvas: coordinate-positioned nodes + drawn wiring ---- */
.oh-flow {
  flex: 1; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, var(--line) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0 / 22px 22px;
  background-color: var(--bg-subtle);
}
.oh-flow-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible;
               pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.oh-fnode {
  position: absolute; width: 198px; height: 84px; background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 4px solid var(--nodehue, var(--p-input));
  border-radius: var(--r-node); box-shadow: var(--e1); padding: 9px 12px; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden;
}
.oh-fnode .ftop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.oh-fnode .fp { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nodehue);
                white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; }
.oh-fnode .fsp { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.oh-fnode .fsub { font-size: 8.5px; font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--fg-muted);
                  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 4px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.oh-fnode .flift { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--success); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.oh-fnode .fn { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 1px;
                white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.oh-fnode .fid { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--fg-faint);
                 white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.oh-fnode .ff { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--fg-muted);
                white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin-top: 3px; }
.oh-fop {
  position: absolute; height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid var(--operator);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--panel); color: var(--operator);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; z-index: 1;
}
.oh-flbl {
  position: absolute; z-index: 1; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em;
  background: var(--bg-subtle); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
  white-space: nowrap; transform: translateX(-50%);
}
.oh-flbl.loop { color: var(--p-loop); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--p-loop) 40%, transparent); }
.oh-flbl.pass { color: var(--success); }
.oh-fcall {
  position: absolute; z-index: 1; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-weak);
  border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 2px 7px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.oh-edge-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); align-self: center; font-style: italic; }
.oh-validity {
  position: absolute; bottom: 16px; left: 26px; right: 26px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--success);
  background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 30%, var(--line));
  border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 8px 12px;
}

/* ============================================================
   COMPARISON & RECOMMENDATION  (scored rubric)
   ============================================================ */
.oh-cmp { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); overflow: hidden;
          padding: 34px 38px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; }
.oh-cmp h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700;
             letter-spacing: -.015em; margin: 0; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-cmp .sub { font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.oh-cmp-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.55fr 1fr; gap: 30px; align-items: start; }

.oh-rubric { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
.oh-rubric th, .oh-rubric td { text-align: left; padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.oh-rubric thead th { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--fg-muted);
                      text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }
.oh-rubric .pr { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 500; width: 38%; }
.oh-rubric .pr small { display: block; color: var(--fg-faint); font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 1px; }
.oh-rubric td.sc { text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600; width: 14%; }
.oh-rubric tfoot td { font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); border-top: 2px solid var(--line-strong); border-bottom: none; }
.oh-rubric tfoot td.sc { color: var(--accent); }
.oh-sccell { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.oh-scdots { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; }
.oh-scdot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--line-strong); }
.oh-scdot.on { background: var(--accent); }
.oh-col-win { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent); }

.oh-cmp-aside { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.oh-pick { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
           padding: 16px 18px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.oh-pick .tag { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
                color: var(--accent); }
.oh-pick h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; margin: 5px 0 8px; color: var(--fg); }
.oh-pick p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0; }
.oh-note { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 13px 15px; background: var(--panel-2); }
.oh-note h4 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
              color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.oh-note ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; }
.oh-note li { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.oh-note li b { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.oh-note li.risk b { color: var(--danger); }

    3. Layout + site styles — OhTopBar, hero, sections, OhAppShell, and the new OhLayout + OhTable¶

    /* =============================================================================
   shared/oh-site.css — SHARED SITE KIT (chrome + skeletons + primitive pages)
   -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Any new brand in the family (Teleon, the Open*Hubs, …) builds on THIS so it
   inherits identical chrome, page skeletons, and primitive pages (sign in/up,
   billing, usage, settings) — only the accent color differs.

   How a new site uses it:
     <div class="oh dir-s theme-light oh-site" style="--accent:#6d5ef0">
       … kit components (OhTopBar / OhAppShell / OhFooter / Oh* pages) …
     </div>

   `--accent` is the ONLY required brand input — every accent-derived token below
   cascades from it, so one variable re-themes the whole kit.
   All layout reuses the canonical primitives from oh-components.css
   (.oh-card, .oh-btn, .oh-badge, .oh-table, .oh-field, .oh-input, .oh-switch,
   .oh-setrow) and the scale vars (--fs-*, --pad-*, --h-topbar, --maxw-site).
   ============================================================================= */

/* ---- accent derivation: set --accent, get a coherent set ---- */
.oh-site {
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;
  --accent-weak: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent);
  --accent-deep: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 76%, #000);
  --p-action: var(--accent);
  min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg);
}
.oh-site .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
.ohs-wrap { max-width: var(--maxw-site); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 28px; }
.ohs-spacer { flex: 1; }
.ohs-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-eyebrow); font-weight: 700;
               letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }

/* ---- brand logo ---- */
.ohs-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
.ohs-logo-mk { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center;
               border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 15px; }
.ohs-logo-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-logo-name .tld { color: var(--accent); }

/* ---- portfolio switcher (cross-site app menu) ---- */
.ohs-pf { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ohs-pf-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
              border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
              transition: color .12s, border-color .12s; }
.ohs-pf-btn:hover, .ohs-pf.open .ohs-pf-btn { color: var(--accent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, var(--line)); }
.ohs-pf-grid { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; }
.ohs-pf-cv { font-size: 9px; opacity: .65; }
.ohs-pf-menu { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); left: 0; z-index: 50; width: 308px; padding: 8px;
               background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--e2);
               animation: ohs-pf-in .14s var(--ease); }
@keyframes ohs-pf-in { from { transform: translateY(-4px); } to { transform: none; } }
.ohs-pf-head { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 6px 8px 2px; }
.ohs-pf-seclabel { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 10px 8px 4px; }
.ohs-pf-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 8px; border-radius: var(--r-md); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
.ohs-pf-item:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.ohs-pf-item.cur { background: var(--accent-weak); cursor: default; }
.ohs-pf-mk { width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px;
             background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ent) 16%, transparent); color: var(--ent); }
.ohs-pf-id { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.25; }
.ohs-pf-id .nm { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-pf-id .kd { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ohs-pf-here { margin-left: auto; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* ---- marketing top bar ---- */
.ohs-top { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; height: var(--h-topbar);
           padding: 0 28px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
           border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-top-nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; }
.ohs-top-nav a { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
.ohs-top-nav a:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-top-r { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.ohs-navlink { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 550; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.ohs-navlink:hover { color: var(--fg); }

/* ---- theme toggle (shared) ---- */
.ohs-theme { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line);
             border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer;
             transition: color .12s, border-color .12s; }
.ohs-theme:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, var(--line)); }

/* ---- hero skeleton ---- */
.ohs-hero { padding: 76px 0 60px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-hero .ohs-eyebrow { display: block; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.ohs-hero h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h1); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.03em;
               font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); margin: 0; max-width: 18ch; text-wrap: balance; }
.ohs-hero h1 .tint { color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-hero .lede { font-size: var(--fs-lead); line-height: var(--lh-lead); color: var(--fg-muted); max-width: 60ch; margin: 22px 0 0; }
.ohs-cta { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 28px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
/* two-column hero (when an aside is supplied) — fills the right side */
.ohs-hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.08fr .92fr; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }

/* ---- section skeleton ---- */
.ohs-section { padding: 64px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-section-label { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em;
                     text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin: 0 0 24px; }
.ohs-section-label::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
.ohs-section h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h2); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.025em;
                  font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 16px; text-wrap: balance; }
.ohs-section .ohs-body { font-size: var(--fs-body); line-height: 1.62; color: var(--fg-muted); max-width: 62ch; }
.ohs-section .ohs-body strong { color: var(--fg); font-weight: 650; }
.ohs-grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-top: 32px; }
.ohs-feature { padding: 22px; }
.ohs-feature .fi { font-size: 22px; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.ohs-feature h4 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 7px; }
.ohs-feature p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0; }

/* ---- CTA band ---- */
.ohs-band { padding: 70px 0; text-align: center; background: var(--accent-weak); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-band h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h2); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.025em; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.ohs-band p { font-size: 16px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 24px; }
.ohs-band .ohs-cta { justify-content: center; }

/* ---- footer ---- */
.ohs-foot { padding: 40px 0 60px; }
.ohs-foot-grid { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ohs-foot-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-foot-tag { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); margin-top: 4px; }
.ohs-foot-cols { display: flex; gap: 52px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ohs-foot-col h5 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.ohs-foot-col a { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 9px; }
.ohs-foot-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

/* =====================  APP SHELL  ===================== */
.ohs-app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 248px 1fr; min-height: 100vh; }
.ohs-side { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 22px 16px;
            background: var(--panel-2); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-side-top { padding: 4px 8px 14px; }
.ohs-side-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; flex: 1; }
.ohs-side-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-md); font-size: 14px;
                 font-weight: 550; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background .12s, color .12s; text-decoration: none; }
.ohs-side-link .g { font-size: 15px; width: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-side-link:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-side-link.on { background: var(--accent-weak); color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-side-link.on .g { color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-side-foot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 8px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-side-foot-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.ohs-main { min-width: 0; }
/* grouped / collapsible nav (richer sidebars, e.g. OpenHubForAI) */
.ohs-side-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.ohs-side-sec { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
                font-family: inherit; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint);
                padding: 12px 12px 5px; }
.ohs-side-sec:hover { color: var(--fg-muted); }
.ohs-side-sec .cv { font-size: 9px; }
.ohs-side-foot .ohs-side-link { padding: 8px 12px; }
/* sidebar search trigger (opens the ⌘K palette) */
.ohs-side-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; margin: 4px 0 8px; padding: 8px 11px; cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-faint); background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); transition: border-color .12s, color .12s; }
.ohs-side-search:hover { color: var(--fg-muted); border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.ohs-side-search-l { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.ohs-side-search .oh-kbd { margin-left: auto; }
/* sticky page topbar (breadcrumb / search) */
.ohs-topbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 54px; padding: 0 24px;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
.ohs-page { max-width: 1040px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 34px 36px 64px; }
.ohs-page.narrow { max-width: 720px; }

/* ---- page head ---- */
.ohs-pagehead { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.ohs-pagehead h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-page-title); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); margin: 8px 0 0; }
.ohs-pagehead p { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 10px 0 0; max-width: 64ch; }
.ohs-pagehead-actions { display: flex; gap: 9px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* ---- rollup stats (dashboards/usage) ---- */
.ohs-rollup { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.ohs-roll { padding: 16px 18px; }
.ohs-roll .v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.ohs-roll .k { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 3px; }

/* =====================  PRIMITIVE PAGES  ===================== */
/* auth (sign in / sign up) — centered card */
.ohs-auth { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 40px 20px; }
.ohs-auth-card { width: 100%; max-width: 400px; padding: 32px; }
.ohs-auth-logo { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.ohs-auth h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); text-align: center; margin: 0 0 6px; }
.ohs-auth .sub { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); text-align: center; margin: 0 0 24px; }
.ohs-auth .oh-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: 6px; }
.ohs-auth-alt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); text-align: center; margin-top: 18px; }
.ohs-auth-alt a { color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.ohs-field-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.ohs-forgot { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
.ohs-forgot:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.ohs-contact-card { max-width: 460px; }
.ohs-auth textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg);
                     background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 11px 13px; resize: vertical; }
.ohs-auth textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); }

/* pricing tiers */
.ohs-pricing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; align-items: stretch; }
.ohs-tier { padding: 26px 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative; }
.ohs-tier.featured { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent); }
.ohs-tier-flag { position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 22px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase;
                 color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; }
.ohs-tier .tier-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-tier .tier-price { margin: 10px 0 4px; }
.ohs-tier .tier-price .amt { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-tier .tier-price .per { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-tier .tier-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.ohs-tier .tier-feats { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; flex: 1; }
.ohs-tier .tier-feats li { position: relative; padding-left: 22px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-tier .tier-feats li::before { content: '✓'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
.ohs-tier .oh-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
.ohs-oauth { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.ohs-oauth-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; padding: 10px;
                 border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--bg); font-family: inherit;
                 font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; }
.ohs-oauth-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: 11px; margin: 4px 0 16px; }
.ohs-divider::before, .ohs-divider::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }

/* billing — plan card + invoices */
.ohs-plan { padding: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.ohs-plan .pl { min-width: 0; }
.ohs-plan .pl .name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-plan .pl .desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.ohs-plan .price { text-align: right; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ohs-plan .price .amt { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-plan .price .per { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-meter { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-subtle); overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0 4px; }
.ohs-meter > i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); }
.ohs-meter-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); }

/* usage — metric cards */
.ohs-usage-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.ohs-usage-card { padding: 20px; }
.ohs-usage-card .um-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.ohs-usage-card .um-k { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.ohs-usage-card .um-v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-bars { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 5px; height: 56px; }
.ohs-bars i { flex: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--bg-subtle)); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; }
.ohs-bars i.hi { background: var(--accent); }

/* settings page sections (uses oh-setrow) */
.ohs-settings-sec { margin-bottom: 22px; }
.ohs-settings-sec h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 12px; }

/* console: dashboard / keys / team / audit */
.ohs-card-h { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.ohs-hint { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-danger { color: var(--danger) !important; }
.ohs-dash-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr; gap: 16px; align-items: start; }
.ohs-dash-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.ohs-activity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ohs-act { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-act:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.ohs-act .ai { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--accent-weak); color: var(--accent); font-size: 13px; }
.ohs-act .at { flex: 1; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-act .aw { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); white-space: nowrap; }
.ohs-planmini .pm-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-quick { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.ohs-quick-item { text-align: left; font-family: inherit; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .12s; }
.ohs-quick-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-quick-item .qt { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-quick-item .qd { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 2px 0 6px; }
.ohs-quick-item .qc { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-invite { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ohs-member { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; }
.ohs-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.ohs-member .mn { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-member .me { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-evln { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
.ohs-evic { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--accent-weak); color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; }
.ohs-evic.warn { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 16%, transparent); color: var(--warning); }

/* onboarding */
.ohs-onb { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.ohs-onb-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 14px 16px; }
.ohs-onb-step.done { opacity: .7; }
.ohs-onb-ck { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-weak); }
.ohs-onb-step.done .ohs-onb-ck { color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); }
.ohs-onb-b { flex: 1; }
.ohs-onb-b .t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-onb-b .d { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); margin-top: 2px; }

/* notifications */
.ohs-noti .at { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ohs-noti .at b { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-noti .nd { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.ohs-noti.unread { position: relative; }
.ohs-noti.unread::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }

/* status */
.ohs-status-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-status-banner .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }
.ohs-status-banner.up .dot { background: var(--success); }
.ohs-status-banner.deg .dot { background: var(--warning); }
.ohs-status-row .ctrl { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ohs-stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: capitalize; }
.ohs-stat .d { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
.ohs-stat.s-operational { color: var(--success); } .ohs-stat.s-operational .d { background: var(--success); }
.ohs-stat.s-degraded { color: var(--warning); } .ohs-stat.s-degraded .d { background: var(--warning); }
.ohs-stat.s-down { color: var(--danger); } .ohs-stat.s-down .d { background: var(--danger); }

/* changelog */
.ohs-chlog { padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohs-chlog:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.ohs-chlog-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.ohs-chlog-head .mono { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-chlog-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.ohs-chlog-list li { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg-muted); }

/* legal */
.ohs-legal .oh-card p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 14px; }
.ohs-legal .oh-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); margin: 20px 0 8px; }

/* 404 */
.ohs-notfound { text-align: center; padding-top: 72px; }
.ohs-404 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(72px, 12vw, 132px); font-weight: 800; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.04em;
           color: var(--accent); opacity: .9; }
.ohs-notfound h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h2); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--fg); margin: 18px 0 0; }
.ohs-notfound p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--fg-muted); max-width: 46ch; margin: 14px auto 0; }
.ohs-notfound .ohs-cta { justify-content: center; margin-top: 26px; }

/* about / mission */
.ohs-about-lede p { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--fg); margin: 0; text-wrap: pretty; }
.ohs-about-family { margin-top: 34px; }
.ohs-about-family .ohs-section-label { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.ohs-about-ent { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; text-decoration: none; }
.ohs-about-ent .ohs-pf-mk { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.ohs-about-ent .nm { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-about-ent .kd { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ent); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.ohs-about-ent p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0; }

/* case studies — index grid */
.ohs-case-grid { align-items: stretch; }
.ohs-case-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.ohs-case-meta { margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1; }
.ohs-case-sector { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line)); background: var(--accent-weak); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; }
.ohs-case-client { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-faint); letter-spacing: .03em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ohs-case-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--fg); margin: 4px 0 8px; line-height: 1.2; }
.ohs-case-summary { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 14px; }
.ohs-case-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); width: 100%; }
.ohs-case-stat .v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1; }
.ohs-case-stat .k { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.ohs-case-go { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); }

/* case study — detail */
.ohs-back { background: none; border: none; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.ohs-back:hover { color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-cs-head { max-width: 60ch; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.ohs-cs-sector { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.ohs-cs-head h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h2); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.025em; color: var(--fg); margin: 12px 0 12px; line-height: 1.08; text-wrap: balance; }
.ohs-cs-summary { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg-muted); margin: 0 0 14px; }
.ohs-cs-client { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); letter-spacing: .03em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ohs-cs-metrics { margin-bottom: 30px; }
.ohs-cs-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 300px; gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
.ohs-cs-sec { margin-bottom: 26px; }
.ohs-cs-sec p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--fg); margin: 8px 0 0; text-wrap: pretty; }
.ohs-cs-steps { margin: 10px 0 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: cs; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.ohs-cs-steps li { position: relative; padding-left: 34px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg); counter-increment: cs; }
.ohs-cs-steps li::before { content: counter(cs); position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, var(--line)); border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--accent-weak); }
.ohs-cs-out { margin: 10px 0 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; }
.ohs-cs-out li { position: relative; padding-left: 26px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--fg); }
.ohs-cs-out li::before { content: '✓'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
.ohs-cs-aside { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; position: sticky; top: 20px; }
.ohs-cs-quote p { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--fg); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.ohs-cs-quote .who { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg-muted); }
.ohs-cs-cta .t { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.ohs-cs-next { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 3px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.ohs-cs-next .l { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohs-cs-next .n { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .ohs-cs-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ohs-cs-aside { position: static; } }

/* experiments + tracking dev panel (floating, bottom-left) */
.ohx { position: fixed; left: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 200; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; font-family: var(--font-display); }
.ohx-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
               border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: var(--fg-muted); box-shadow: var(--e1); font: inherit; transition: color .12s, border-color .12s; }
.ohx-trigger:hover, .ohx.open .ohx-trigger { color: var(--accent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, var(--line)); }
.ohx-trigger .g { font-size: 14px; }
.ohx-trigger .lbl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.ohx-panel { order: -1; width: 304px; max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px; border-radius: var(--r-lg);
             background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--e2); }
.ohx-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.ohx-x { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg-faint); background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 7px; cursor: pointer; }
.ohx-x:hover { color: var(--danger); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, var(--line)); }
.ohx-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohx-exp { padding: 8px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohx-exp:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
.ohx-exp-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.ohx-exp-h .k { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
.ohx-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-weak); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; }
.ohx-variants { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.ohx-var { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
           border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-subtle); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; text-align: left; transition: border-color .12s, background .12s; }
.ohx-var:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.ohx-var.on { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-weak); }
.ohx-var .vid { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--fg); }
.ohx-var .vmetrics { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); }

.ohx-foot { margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--fg-faint); line-height: 1.5; }

/* command palette (⌘K) */
.ohk-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 300; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 28%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding-top: 13vh; }
.ohk-modal { width: 560px; max-width: 92vw; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--e3); overflow: hidden; }
.ohk-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 15px 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.ohk-mag { color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: 16px; }
.ohk-input input { flex: 1; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--fg); font-size: 16px; font-family: inherit; }
.ohk-input input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-faint); }
.ohk-list { max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 6px; }
.ohk-group { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint); padding: 10px 12px 4px; }
.ohk-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-md); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--fg); }
.ohk-item.on { background: var(--accent-weak); color: var(--accent); }
.ohk-ic { width: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--fg-muted); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ohk-item.on .ohk-ic { color: var(--accent); }
.ohk-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
